name: App Launcher Icon
description: A desktop icon that opens your chosen apps.

apps.label: Apps to open
apps.description: One command per line. All of them start when you click the icon.

iconName.label: Icon name
iconName.description: A Material Symbols name. Ignored if an image is set.

iconImage.label: Icon image
iconImage.description: Full path to an image. Drop an image on the icon to set it, or clear this to use the icon name.

showBackground.label: Show background
showBackground.description: The filled card behind the image. Turn off to show only the image.

outlineWidth.label: Outline width
outlineWidth.description: The border around the card. 0 removes it.

outlineColorMode.label: Outline color
outlineColorMode.description: Theme follows the shell's own outline color.

outlineCustomColor.label: Custom color
outlineCustomColor.description: A hex code such as #ff7a8c. Used only when Outline color is Custom.

roundOutline.label: Round the outline
roundOutline.description: On: rounded corners. Off: square corners.

roundImage.label: Round the image
roundImage.description: On: the picture itself gets rounded corners. Off: it stays rectangular.

cornerRadius.label: Corner radius
cornerRadius.description: Used by the outline and the image when they are rounded.

imageFill.label: Image fill
imageFill.description: How much of the icon the image covers. Use 100 with no background.
